# Replica Architect, plan the stack, database and API for your app clone

Curated by Skill Harbor: the planning step of the 11-skill Replica pack. Replica Architect reads your recon map and turns the inferred data model into a real plan: a boring, managed stack with one line of why per layer, a SQL schema with indexes and access rules, every API route listed by flow, and a build order that starts with a thin vertical slice. It refuses to plan from memory, so if there is no recon map it stops and points you to Replica Recon first. Only official, public APIs with your own keys are used, never the original app's private endpoints. By @Jakeschincariol, listed here with credit to its creator. Skill Harbor never reviews the code of a listed skill, so review it yourself before use.
